category: managed WireGuard gateway with a static public IP

free_tier.stated: No free tier and no trial. "Core $15 / month" and "Core Plus $29 / month"; "Plans from $15/month".

egress.terms: "450 GB monthly data transfer" on Core and "900 GB monthly data transfer" on Core Plus. No overage price is published; the next step offered is Custom.; ingress: tcp+udp
egress.free_allowance: "450 GB monthly data transfer" on Core and "900 GB monthly data transfer" on Core Plus. No overage price is published; the next step offered is Custom.

interface_detail: Dashboard for peers and usage; no API named.
chaining: Composable with nothing else: the volume cap is the wall, and the inbound tier already includes the address.

limits.value: 450 GB per month on Core, 900 GB on Core Plus

binding_note: 900 GB is 0.818 TiB, so 1 TiB/month needs the Custom tier, and the price of that is a quote. At USD 29 for 0.9 TB the row is about USD 32 per TiB, the most expensive volume.

identity_cost.detail: A business-oriented paid signup; the Custom tier routes through sales. The signup form was not read.

reliability_note: Dedicated gateway per customer with no shared contention; 24/7 operations is claimed, no SLA figure published for the listed tiers.
confidence_note: Both tiers, their transfer caps and the inbound/outbound split are first-party. A quote for Custom would show what 1 TiB actually costs.

evidence.proved: Core USD 15/month, 450 GB, outbound only; Core Plus USD 29/month, 900 GB, inbound TCP/UDP port forwarding; 10 peers; Custom by quote
"One dedicated gateway. One stable public IP. Up to 10 peers included. No per-user licensing."

price_per_tb_month: USD 15 per month for Core (450 GB, outbound); USD 29 per month for Core Plus (900 GB, inbound)
notes: The Core tier cannot answer test I at all: its product is outbound egress, and inbound is the thing Core Plus sells. The vendor is operated by APYL and markets to business and remote-site connectivity, which sets the price floor.

extras.wg_detail: Peers are issued from the dashboard: "Create and revoke peers, generate configurations, and monitor usage from one dashboard." Inbound requires the higher tier: Core Plus adds "Configurable inbound TCP/UDP port forwarding" while Core is "Outbound connectivity" only.
extras.volume_stated: "450 GB monthly data transfer" on Core and "900 GB monthly data transfer" on Core Plus. No overage price is published; the next step offered is Custom.
extras.transit_note: APYL operates the gateways and the addresses.
